output: Hypothesis: During the Younger Bronze Age (1100-500 BCE), the principal component value of PC1 for Pottery Decoration (Zkeverz) at the beginning of the period (1100 BCE) differs significantly from the subsequent time horizons (1000 to 500 BCE). This hypothesis is based on the analysis of the "capital.csv" dataset, where the Zkeverz values at 1100 BCE (0.97) are significantly different from the mean Zkeverz values in the subsequent time horizons (1.53), with a p-value of 0.0, indicating statistical significance. The principal component value of PC1 for Pottery Form (ZKeform) does not show a significant difference between the beginning of the period and the subsequent time horizons due to unreliable t-test results.
